newsitem.title: USA: Iowa - S Minn fed cattle market not established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa - S Minn fed cattle market not established - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not established, compared with Thursday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow, with demand and seller interest light. Offerings also were light. Inclement weather disrupting trade.
